objectives: Complete the five priority user stories
All Must acceptance checks pass by the E submission. No open critical defect.
At least 9 of 10 setup trials finish within 2 minutes. At least 27 of 30 approved speaking trials become audible within 3 seconds.
Test whether listeners hear questions more easily
At least 75% positive feedback from at least 5 volunteer reviewers. Report counts and the small sample.
Keep microphone use under explicit control
Zero unauthorized transmissions in misuse tests. No saved audio or transcripts. An alternative speaking route remains available.

requirements.feature: Temporary browser session and QR or code join
requirements.story: As a student, I want to join a temporary room session without installing an app so that I can participate quickly.
requirements.acceptance: A valid code joins the correct session. An expired or ended session rejects joining. Denying microphone permission leaves the interface usable. At least 9 of 10 timed setup trials finish within 2 minutes.
requirements.evidence: ClassMic in-class SMART note; prior ClassMic charter

requirements.feature: Speaking queue with approval, mute, removal and end controls
requirements.story: As an instructor, I want to choose and stop speakers so that I can manage classroom discussion.
requirements.acceptance: One request appears once in the queue. Only the approved student may transmit. Mute, removal, timeout and end session stop transmission. Concurrent requests never create two active speakers. All control and misuse checks pass.
requirements.evidence: ClassMic in-class SMART note; prior ClassMic charter

requirements.feature: One approved phone transmits to a laptop and connected speaker
requirements.story: As a student, I want to speak through my phone after approval so that other people in the room can hear my question.
requirements.acceptance: Microphone notice and permission precede capture. Audio transmits only during approved push to talk and stops on release or revocation. At least 27 of 30 scripted trials become audible within 3 seconds of approval when the tester is ready to speak. Report median and 95th percentile one-way audio delay separately. The 95th percentile must not exceed 150 milliseconds. No sustained feedback is acceptable.
requirements.status: Proposed - device and AV validation pending
requirements.evidence: ClassMic SMART note; prior charter; technical feasibility still untested

requirements.feature: Clear permission, connection and alternative participation paths
requirements.story: As a participant who cannot use a phone microphone, I want another way to contribute so that I am not excluded.
requirements.persona: Student with device or access barrier
requirements.acceptance: Permission denial and disconnection show a clear next step. The instructor can repeat a question or provide an available physical microphone. Keyboard navigation and readable control labels pass the agreed review. Rejoining never restores a previous speaking approval.
requirements.evidence: Prior ClassMic charter and plan; user validation pending

requirements.feature: Test record and anonymous feedback without stored speech
requirements.story: As the project manager, I want a record of test outcomes and feedback so that I can recommend whether further testing is worthwhile.
requirements.acceptance: The report covers every Must check, 10 setup trials, 30 speaking trials and feedback from at least 5 volunteers. At least 75% report easier audibility. Save results and minimal test metadata only. Report failures, sample limits and open defects. No audio or transcript is saved.
requirements.evidence: ClassMic SMART note and prior charter; sample sizes proposed for course feasibility
